_comment: Rework pass — Umair QC 2026-08-19. (1) frontend re-captured with theme chrome + admin affordances stripped BEFORE freeze; (2) builder re-captured with Image Choices and Icon Choices toggled ON so the real picker sub-UI exists in markup (it renders on toggle, so it was never captured — and inventing it is barred by production truth).

variants._note: A1: strip banner/nav/search/sidebar/footer, the admin-only 'Edit Form' link, and the noscript notice. The FORM itself is untouched — this is framing, not fabrication.

steps.eval: document.querySelectorAll('header, footer, nav, aside, [role=banner], [role=complementary], [role=contentinfo], [role=navigation], form[role=search], .site-header, .site-footer, .sidebar, #sidebar, #secondary, .widget-area, .et_pb_menu, #main-header, #top-header, #et-top-navigation, .et_search_outer, #footer, #et-footer-nav, #main-footer').forEach(function(n){ n.remove(); });

var f=document.querySelector('.wpforms-container'); if(f){ var host=document.createElement('div'); host.id='wpf-solo'; host.style.cssText='max-width:820px;margin:64px auto;padding:0 24px;'; document.body.innerHTML=''; document.body.appendChild(host); host.appendChild(f); document.body.style.background='#ffffff'; }

variants._note: B16: Image Choices ON. Toggling renders the per-choice image picker sub-UI, which no existing capture contains.
B16: Icon Choices ON — separate sub-UI (icon picker + color + size), separate capture.
